book.name: 2 Timocheyo
book.title: Baluwa jhuubhele jha Pauli kwa Timocheyo

content: Ne Napauli natenga jwa Kilichitu Yecho kwa kupala Chapanga. Ndumitwe ndangache ughome gwatulaghila Chapanga mu kulombana na Kilichitu Yecho.
Ninnyandikii mwe ma Timocheyo ma mwanango jhunimpahii hake. Ninnyope kwa Chapanga Tate gwito na Kilichitu Yecho Bhambo gwito ampele umbone na kiya na uteeke.
Uchengulo na malobhe gha kuleke mwojho
Ninchenguu Chapanga jhunintumikila kwa mwojho gwambone ngita chibhatehila akahoko bhango, ninchenguu kila pininkomboka machiko ghoha mu kunnyopa kwango kilo na muhe.
Pinikomboka maholi ghino mmi na kilolo hake kummona, kupala ndwele luhangano kumwojho.
Ndi punikomboka kihobholelo chino cha uchakaka, kihobholelo chakibhanacho mbujha gwino Loisi na hele majhe gwino Eunike. Manye kubhehe helahela namwe nkwete kihobholelo chenie.
Nhwalo gwa gheniya nanikombocha nnyedelele kukihenge lihengo likitoi champii Chapanga machiko ghanimekila mabhoko gwango.
Nhwalo Chapanga atupii jhe Uhuke gwake jwatutenda tujhoghope, nambo atupekiye Uhuke jwatupekeye makakala na mapalano na mwojho gwa kukilongocha tabhete.

Yene, mangakola jhe hone kwatangachii Bhambo gwito, kabhele mangakola jhe hone nhwalo gwango nenga jhundabhitwe mu kipungo kwa nhwalo gwake. Nambo uhimbilile mu malagho pamonga na nenga kwa nhwalo jha Lilobhe lya Mbone kwa kutangatilwa na makakala gha Chapanga.

Chapanga atukombwii, atukemite tutame utamo gwa unyahinyahi, chi nhwalo gwa itendwa hito yambone, nambo ngita chapahii jwenio Chapanga na kwa umbone gwake. Ngatupila umbone gwenio kupete Kilichitu Yecho kabula nnema nakupanganwa jhe.

Nambo umbone uyekulilwe hotuhotu kwito ngohe kwa kuhika kwa Nkomboche gwito, ndi Kilichitu Yecho. Jwenie ahangabhine makakala gha kuwegha na kwa ndela jha Lilobhe lya Mbone ngayekwila ndaa ughome gwa machiko ghoha gwangapeta.
Chapanga ngahagwila ne mme natenga na mmola kwa nhwalo jwa kwatangachii bhando Lilobhe lya Mbone,
gheniya ndi ghighameka naghe ngoheno. Nambo ne nipwele jhe nhwalo chakaka niumanye hotuhotu jhunihobholela, kabhele manye jwenie nambekeya ulonda, ade lichiko lela.
Nkamuu mbone mabholo gha uchakaka ghinimmolite ngita kilandanikiho kwino. Nnyendelele mu kihobholelo na mapalano ghabhii mu kulombana na Kilichitu Yecho.
Kilebhe chela chamaha mukilonde kwa makakala gha Uhuke gwa Chapanga jwaitama nkate jhito.
Ngita chiumanye, bhando bhoha bhubhabhii ku kilambo cha ku Asiya bhannekite, pakate jhabhe abhii Fugelo na Helimogene.
Ninnyopa Bhambo aikole kiya nyumba jha Onesifolo, kwa nhwalo akauhanganiche mwojho gwango pipipi. Ngolite jhe hone nhwalo gwa kutabhwa kwango,
pahikita tu ku kilambo chuku Loma, ngambaliya hake ade ngatukongina.
Ninyopa Bhambo ankole kiya kwa lichiko lela luhadabulo pulupa kuhika! Na mwenga umanye twe ghamaha ghantendii kwenio ku Epecho.
